turn.question: Export the award lines to Excel.
turn.answer: The award assignment table has been exported to Excel. You can find the file at `/Users/muskmuskanbaranwalanbaranwal/Projects/rfx-quote-compare/data/outbox/analysis/award_assignments_export.xlsx`. It includes the line item IDs, descriptions, assigned vendors, and the unit prices used for the assignment.

args.query:
SELECT 
  line_item.id AS line_item_id,
  line_item.description_json->>'$.value' AS description,
  vendor.name AS assigned_vendor,
  normalized_quote.unit_price_inr_ex_tax AS unit_price_inr
FROM normalized_quote
JOIN line_item ON normalized_quote.line_item_id = line_item.id
JOIN quote ON normalized_quote.quote_id = quote.id
JOIN response ON quote.response_id = response.id
JOIN vendor ON response.vendor_id = vendor.id
WHERE (
  (vendor.name = 'Vardhan Packaging Works Pvt. Ltd.' AND normalized_quote.line_item_id IN ('L01', 'L02', 'L03', 'L04', 'L05', 'L07', 'L08', 'L09', 'L10', 'L11', 'L12', 'L13', 'L14', 'L15', 'L16', 'L17', 'L18', 'L19', 'L20', 'L21', 'L22', 'L24', 'L25', 'L26', 'L27', 'L28', 'L29', 'L30'))
  OR 
  (vendor.name = 'Ganesh Kraft Traders' AND normalized_quote.line_item_id IN ('L06', 'L23'))
)
args.name: award_assignments_export
